proposition: Melvin-Koushki's timeline says copies of Sharḥ al-Basmala were sent to both Ulugh Beg and Qāżīzāda Rūmī, whereas the work entry documents a copy sent to Qāżīzāda and only a marginal dedication to Ulugh Beg; the two accounts are not the same claim and the dissertation does not reconcile them on these pages.
